senses.zh_definition: 专有名称 Elise；可核实的用例包括 Lotus Elise 跑车车型，但输入包不足以确定这里具体指什么。
senses.en_definition: A proper name, attested in the sports-car model name Lotus Elise; its intended referent here is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas, antaranya nama model kereta sukan Lotus Elise; rujukan khusus dalam input belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 未核实为标准马来语普通词，不能赋予普通词义或标为官方词条。以下搭配与例句仅演示已核实的汽车名称用法，不代表已确认输入词的所指，也不声称具有特定搭配频率。参见 [Lotus 官方：Elise](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-GB/lotus-story/road-cars/elise)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Model Lotus Elise diperkenalkan kepada umum di Frankfurt pada tahun 1995.
dual_scenarios.zh: Lotus Elise 车型于1995年在法兰克福首次公开亮相。

dual_scenarios.zh: 我想近距离看看那辆 Lotus Elise。

etymology.historical_story: One documented naming story belongs specifically to the Lotus Elise. Lotus unveiled the car at Frankfurt in 1995 and named it after Elisa, granddaughter of its then chairman Romano Artioli. This explains that vehicle's name, but it does not establish which Elise the input denotes or make elise a Malay common word. Source: [Lotus](https://www.lotuscars.com/en-GB/lotus-story/road-cars/elise).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Elise 当作完整名称记忆；在汽车语境中联想 Lotus Elise，不作马来语词缀拆分。
